name: API Mocking: Intercept and Conditionally Respond
task: Write a Playwright test that uses page.route() to mock the https://www.saucedemo.com inventory API. Intercept requests to /inventory.html and serve a custom HTML page showing exactly 3 products (not the default 6). Verify the page renders only 3 products. Use standard_user / secret_sauce.
passCriteria: Uses page.route() or context.route() to intercept requests
Test verifies page shows exactly 3 products via assertion
Login still works (mocking is scoped correctly)
failCriteria: No network interception -- hits live API only
Mocks so aggressively that login breaks
Assertion doesn't verify the correct product count
